corrections.title: Downgrade generic SEE vs 3v3 The Stranger to C/50 after owner-observed loss
corrections.rationale: Owner-approved GAC-SEE-STR1 Option A from issue #178, independently scoped in #188. Downgrade only generic SEE attacker against The Stranger 3v3 defence from B/52 to C/50, preserving scored non-provisional status; add qualified observed-loss reliability note. Do not alter SEE+Bane or Bane.

evidence.publisher: Owner-approved GAC-SEE-STR1 decision and evidence handover
evidence.supports: Owner reports a 3v3 loss with SEE, Wat Tambor and Savage Opress vs The Stranger, Maul (Hate-Fueled) and Starkiller; no enemy units defeated. Owner approves C tier and 50 planning banners for generic SEE.

provenance.conditions: Observed defence: The Stranger / Maul (Hate-Fueled) / Starkiller, with Starkiller datacron of unknown effects; attack SEE (R10) / Wat Tambor / Savage Opress (GAC omicron). Other support compositions or datacrons may differ.
provenance.confidence: Medium: Owner-observed single loss and owner-approved downgrade; no verified win rate or measured banner average.
provenance.limitations: Single reported defeat, opponent datacron effects unknown. The generic leader-family matchup does not establish equal performance against every Stranger lineup. C/50 is a planning estimate conditional on a win.

affectedReferences.effect: Only generic SEE tier B to C, bannerScore 52 to 50 and reliability notes; preserve BANE and SEE_BANE rows.

runtimeImpact.3v3: The Stranger versus generic SEE changes to C/50 non-provisional with observed-loss warning; BANE C/48 and SEE_BANE S/53 unchanged.
runtimeImpact.counters: Only 3v3 The Stranger generic SEE matchup changes; counter definition and roster requirements unchanged.
runtimeImpact.roundAvailability: none: counter identities, ownership and used/allocation rules unchanged.
runtimeImpact.scoring: Existing C tier / bannerScore 50, no scoring algorithm modifications.

counters.notes: Use Darth Bane with one other non-summoned Sith; leave the third slot empty. SEE + Bane is a separate counter. High risk: recent attempts failed outright. Emergency option only.

Owner-observed 3v3 loss with SEE / Wat Tambor / Savage Opress against The Stranger / Maul (Hate-Fueled) / Starkiller; no enemy defeated. SEE was R10 and Savage had his GAC omicron. Enemy Starkiller had a datacron of unknown effects. Generic SEE is unreliable as a primary counter to this composition; different allies and datacrons may change the outcome. C/50 is a planning estimate for successful wins, not a measured average.
Use Darth Bane with one other non-summoned Sith; leave the third slot empty. SEE + Bane is a separate counter. High risk: recent attempts failed outright. Emergency option only.
